comment: Production happens ON an island and stays there until the network moves it. What an island produces is decided by its ROLE, which its owner sets after capture: 0 resource, 1 factory, 2 defence. worldgen's `kind` is not overridden by that - it is a terrainBonusPermil multiplier when the role suits the ground (resource-rich rock as Resource, natural fortress as Defence). A factory does not produce from nothing: it converts materials, per factory built, which is why a resource island is worth taking first.
